description: This file defines a report parser class for generating seller form reports in an OpenERP/Odoo module related to auctions. It includes methods for calculating taxes, aggregating seller info, and total amounts, and registers the report.

classes.name: seller_form_report
classes.description: A report parser class for generating seller form reports, extending report_sxw.rml_parse.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with helper functions and data.

methods.name: sum_taxes
methods.description: Calculates total taxes for a given lot.

methods.name: seller_info
methods.description: Aggregates seller information and associated lots.

methods.name: grand_seller_total
methods.description: Calculates the grand total amount for a list of objects, including taxes.
